Refactored the codebase to make the algorithm and tests easier to read and extend.

What changed:
- Renamed the count-buffer helpers in [CountingSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/037_counting_sort/src/main/java/countingsort/CountingSort.java#L17) so the flow reads as `sort -> buildPrefixSums -> placeSortedValues`.
- Kept the implementation single-purpose and allocation-free beyond the required counting arrays and output array.
- Reworked [CountingSortTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/037_counting_sort/src/test/java/countingsort/CountingSortTest.java#L11) to use a small `SortCase` helper instead of parallel arrays, which makes adding cases less error-prone.
- Preserved the standard package layout in `src/main/java` and `src/test/java`.
